posts.name: Omniwork
posts.tagline: The Creative Agent OS — create better with desktop AI agents
posts.description: Omniwork is an always-on Creative Agent OS that turns ideas into finished work. Specialized AI agents research, create, monitor, and automate your creative workflows, while a proactive desktop companion keeps projects moving and pushes results, alerts, and progress straight to your screen.

posts.name: VoiceOS App Store
posts.tagline: The app store for voice native apps that lives in your notch
posts.description: The App Store for your voice, where building takes one sentence. Describe what you want "Create an app to help me to journal" and VoiceOS creates the app for you. Share it as a link and anyone can install it in a click.

posts.name: SoloUno
posts.tagline: Take control of hair pulling, nail biting & skin picking
posts.description: SoloUno helps people take control over body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs) such as hair pulling (trichotillomania), skin picking (dermatillomania), and nail biting. Inspired by Habit Reversal Training, CBT, and ACT, it works as a gamified self-help tool. You progress by achieving small daily wins: habit-free challenges and streaks, quick habit logging, trigger analysis, and urge-acceptance sessions. No shame - just steady progress.

posts.name: AgentConnect
posts.tagline: Tag any agent, wherever work happens.
posts.description: AgentConnect is an open-source platform where teams and AI agents work together across Slack, Telegram, Discord, and GitHub. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, DeepSeek, Pi, or any ACP-compatible runtime. Give each agent a role and choose its model, workspace, memory, tools, skills, and permissions. Start work from conversations, pull requests, issues, webhooks, or schedules. Agents can call one another while your team follows the work they are allowed to see from one console.

posts.name: Proxy Tester by ScrapeOps
posts.tagline: Benchmark proxies for reliable, target-specific scraping
posts.description: ScrapeOps Proxy Tester is a technical benchmarking platform for developers, scraping teams, data providers, SaaS companies, and AI agents selecting proxy infrastructure. Submit a target URL to test 20+ residential, datacenter, mobile, Proxy API, and unblocker configurations. It measures real-world success rate, latency, reliability, bandwidth, and estimated cost, then generates a use-case-specific ranking instead of relying on generic provider claims.

posts.name: Prompt Golf
posts.tagline: Prompt Engineering As a Sport
posts.description: Prompt Golf turns prompt engineering into a competitive puzzle game. Across five rounds, coax an out-of-the-box AI into saying an exact target word or phrase in as less characters as possible. Every round has a condition or banned input words. Every character and message adds strokes, so clever, compact prompts climb the live leaderboard. Replay the full course, check live leaderboard, challenge your friends and view their transcripts.

posts.name: Macrobite
posts.tagline: The fastest way to actually get your macros right
posts.description: Macrobite is the fastest way to get your macros right. Snap a photo of your meal and get an instant breakdown of calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Not perfect on the first try? Quick editing closes the gap in seconds, no scrolling through massive food databases. Prefer to talk? Log meals by voice, including through Siri. Track your day from your iPhone widget or Apple Watch without opening the app. Built for people who want accurate macros without the friction of traditional tracking apps.

posts.name: Argos
posts.tagline: The AI that acts as you, right in your browser
posts.description: Most AI just tells you what to do. Argos does it. It works right inside your browser using your own logged-in accounts — clicking, typing, filling forms, and finishing real tasks. Ask it in the sidebar or text it on Telegram/WhatsApp, and it runs live or in the background, then hands you the result. Native in Gmail, Docs and Sheets. Connects GitHub, Slack, Notion and more. Your data stays on your device. Free to start.

posts.name: DocsAlot CLI
posts.tagline: Let Claude or Codex create and maintain good looking docs
posts.description: Claude Code and Codex are great at writing a first draft. DocsAlot turns that draft into a genuinely good-looking docs site, and gives your agent a complete workflow for keeping it current. Ask in plain English to create or pull docs, preview changes, migrate existing content, save versions, and publish only when approved. No commands to memorize or documentation workflow to manage by hand. You describe the outcome; your agent handles the work while you stay in control

posts.name: Persodex
posts.tagline: Your personal CRM that lives on top of your iOS contacts.
posts.description: A smarter contacts app that helps you stay in touch with the people who matter. Or as we like to call it: Contacts with Context. Persodex syncs natively with Apple’s Contacts instead of replacing them. We don‘t even require an account. No import. No migration. No lock-in.

posts.name: DuckDisk
posts.tagline: Table-first storage analysis for Mac, cloud, and SSH
posts.description: DuckDisk is a free, open-source macOS storage analyzer built for people who want answers, not just colorful maps. Its WizTree-style, table-first tree keeps size, allocated space, parent %, item counts, and file-type totals visible while you drill down. Scan local disks, OneDrive, Google Drive, and SSH in one app. Cloud scans use metadata only—file contents are not downloaded. The release is Apple-notarized and available on the Mac App Store.

posts.name: Papaya
posts.tagline: Your sex's private recap — never leaves your phone
posts.description: Papaya listens to you having sex and draws a cartoon about it. Sound and motion only, on-device: no account, no cloud, no audio saved. It gives the night a title. Mine was "Faster than an elevator pitch."

posts.name: ConferenceGrid
posts.tagline: Conference database for B2B teams
posts.description: Look up any company and see every conference it sponsors, exhibits at, or speaks at — 6,000+ conferences, 62,000 speakers, 55,000 sponsor slots in one graph.

posts.name: Workflo
posts.tagline: Mac workspace automation that never sees your screen
posts.description: Workflo sets up your Mac automatically — staging the right windows before a call or a focus block, and restoring your layout when displays change. Runs on Accessibility alone: it structurally cannot read your screen. Native Swift, ~4 MB, one-time purchase, local-only.

posts.name: radiusHQ
posts.tagline: One link replaces your scheduling chaos
posts.description: Your services, prices, calendar, payments, and reminders — all in one beautiful page. Clients book in 30 seconds. You set it up in 10 minutes.

posts.name: Grok Imagine 2.0
posts.tagline: Next-gen AI image generator with segmentation editing.
posts.description: Grok Imagine 2.0 brings major upgrades to Grok's image generation capabilities: significantly better instruction following, sharp text rendering & typography, complex coherent layouts, and precise region editing with Magic Wand.

posts.name: Soup CLI
posts.tagline: Fine-tune an 8B LLM on a 4 GB laptop GPU
posts.description: LoRA keeps the base model frozen: read, never written. So Soup keeps it in system RAM and streams it into the GPU one decoder layer at a time. Peak VRAM becomes one layer instead of the whole model. Measured on an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB: Llama-3.1-8B trains at 119.6 tok/s in 3.32 GB peak. One YAML, one command. SFT, DPO, GRPO, KTO, plus eval, gating and export. Apache-2.0. Every number is published, including the ones I measured and threw away.

posts.name: Good Assistant 2
posts.tagline: Turn life goals into daily progress.
posts.description: Good Assistant 2 turns your goals into daily steps and makes sure they happen. Plans your day with you, tracks progress, and helps you follow through.

posts.name: Bunzee 3.0
posts.tagline: Idea → IA → wireframes → design → build via MCP
posts.description: AI can't build your app right without context—it's just guessing the next token. Bunzee gives it the full picture: it analyzes your idea against real competitors and market data, then breaks everything into structured specs—PRD, IA, wireframes, and designs you can shape from 250+ global app styles. Each step feeds the next, and every one is grounded in objective data, not opinion. Then it all pipes to your AI coding tool over MCP, so your AI builds from real context, not vibes.

posts.name: TAKT
posts.tagline: Stop babysitting AI coding agents — reviews can't be skipped
posts.description: Open-source CLI that turns AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & more) into repeatable YAML workflows: plan → implement → review → fix loops with per-step roles, isolated worktrees, and traceable reports. Reviews can't be silently skipped.

posts.name: Aximote
posts.tagline: The fitness tracker for your car
posts.description: Modern cars generate thousands of data points, yet most drivers barely get access to them. Aximote changes that. We automatically turn your vehicle data into clear insights about trips, charging, consumption, costs and driving behavior — without additional hardware. Understand what happens inside your car, improve how you drive and take control of the data your vehicle already generates.

posts.name: Roomo
posts.tagline: Private, temporary chats. No account required.
posts.description: Roomo is a simple, temporary chat platform that lets you create a private room, share a link, and start talking instantly — no account or email required. Create a room, invite others, chat in real time, share files, and manage participants. Conversations are protected with end-to-end encryption, and rooms automatically expire after 48 hours of inactivity. Fast, private, and built for conversations that don't need to live forever.

posts.name: GA4 Dashboard
posts.tagline: Real-time GA4 Dashboard with 3D Globe & AI Integration
posts.description: Real-time Google Analytics 4 (GA4) dashboard featuring a 3D interactive globe visualization, traffic spike detection, visitor insights, and a standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants. - TheTechBasket/GA4-Dashboard-MCP

posts.name: Orrin
posts.tagline: Your personal money agent, right inside iMessage & WhatsApp
posts.description: Orrin is a personal money agent available through iMessage, WhatsApp, and Telegram. It finds subscriptions and recurring bills from your Gmail, helps you split shared expenses, and turns your income, spending, and goals into practical budgets and savings plans—all through simple conversations.

posts.name: Yeta AI / YouTube Dubbing
posts.tagline: Real-time AI dubbing for any YouTube video
posts.description: Translate and dub any YouTube video in real-time with AI voices in 10+ languages. Paste a link, pick your language, and watch in seconds. Free plan available.

posts.name: Custos — The bouncer for your AI agents
posts.tagline: Stop AI agents from doing things they shouldn't.
posts.description: Custos is a safety and control layer for AI agents. It sits between an agent and the tools it uses—like APIs, files, databases, shell commands, and MCP servers—and checks every action before it runs. You define what the agent is allowed to do, Custos blocks anything outside those rules, and every action is recorded in a tamper-evident audit trail. It’s open source, works with Python and TypeScript, and is built for teams running AI agents in real-world environments.

posts.name: Notoo
posts.tagline: A local-first workspace + 31 file tools. Nothing uploaded.
posts.description: Notoo is a private, in-browser workspace — rich docs, markdown, code, drawings and API requests in one file tree, saved on your device. Plus Notoo Tools: 31 PDF and image utilities that run in your tab. No account, no uploads, no page limits, no watermarks.

posts.name: what it does
posts.tagline: Know what your app does — even the parts you didn't write
posts.description: Most tools tell you what changed in your code. This tells you what your application can do: every entry point, what data each one touches, and whether anything checks who is asking. It reads without running anything. No account, no upload, no telemetry, one command writes a single HTML file that works offline. Scan again and it reports what changed about the behaviour, not which lines moved. MIT and free. A paid GitHub Action runs the same check on every pull request, free on public repos.

posts.name: ProcureTap
posts.tagline: Every US government bid, in one searchable place.
posts.description: Every US federal, state, and local government bid — plus international sources (EU, UK, Canada, World Bank, UNDP) — in one searchable place. 200,000+ bids indexed, 70,000+ currently open, refreshed every 6 hours from 605+ agencies. Full search + bid details free — no card, no view limits. Legacy tools ($1,200-$50,000/yr) hide descriptions behind their paywall. Pro at $99/mo unlocks instant alerts (vs. weekly on free), full document downloads, AI matching, CSV/API export.

posts.name: Xorviex
posts.tagline: Spawn AI agents that orchestrate any task, no code
posts.description: Set the goal. Xorviex spawns the army. The world's first Self-Architecting AI Executive that auto-generates, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute any business objective — 24/7, at scale, without human bottlenecks.

posts.name: AdTown
posts.tagline: The Airbnb for Ad Spaces
posts.description: AdTown connects two sides most people never think to link. Billboard owners and cinema chains sit on unsold ad inventory. Small businesses want offline ads but assume it costs too much, a PVR cinema slide is actually just ₹4,000. Meanwhile hyperlocal spots like restaurants, gyms, or salons with footfall can list their wall, counter, or standee space and earn additional income. A win win for both brands and adspace owners, and also a new income stream for existing businesses.

posts.name: Hiddle
posts.tagline: Product videos for solo founders without a video team
posts.description: Hiddle is the AI video editor for solo founders and marketers without a video team. Describe a launch or feature video in chat, get a real editable composition, not a one-shot you can’t fix. Bring notes, footage, audio, or a URL. Hiddle generates voiceovers, SFX, and music. Ship in your desired format (YouTube / Reels / Square). Chat to create, edit to finish.

posts.name: imageapiai.com
posts.tagline: AI Image Generation API for developers
posts.description: ImageAIAPI is a developer-first AI image generation API that helps teams build AI-powered products without managing complex infrastructure. Generate high-quality images from text prompts through a simple, scalable API. Perfect for SaaS platforms, content creation tools, marketing automation, e-commerce applications, and creative workflows. Fast integration, reliable performance, and production-ready infrastructure.

posts.name: StarryKit
posts.tagline: AI visual design editor for presentations, posters & more
posts.description: StarryKit is an AI-powered visual creation platform that helps you create presentations, posters, reports, and marketing materials, with designs you can actually edit. Go from idea to finished design faster. Create with AI, refine your work, and customize every detail without starting from templates or spending hours fixing AI-generated designs.

posts.name: NovaCheck
posts.tagline: Trust scores for AI-generated code
posts.description: AI coding tools make it incredibly easy to ship code. They also make it incredibly easy to ship code you don’t fully understand. NovaCheck is a local-first trust scanner for AI-generated code. It looks for signals such as: * 👻 Ghost dependencies * 🔐 Exposed secrets * ⚠️ Dangerous code sinks * 🤖 AI-generated security patterns * 📦 Dependency and project inconsistencies * 📊 SARIF-compatible findings NovaCheck runs locally, so your source code doesn’t need to leave your machine.

posts.name: TickClip
posts.tagline: TickClip — The Fiduciary Layer of E-Commerce
posts.description: TickClip is the fiduciary layer of e-commerce—an AI shopping platform built to put consumers first. It analyzes price history, deal quality, product value, and seller signals to deliver clear verdicts: Tick to buy, Clip to wait, or Skip to avoid. With zero commission influencing recommendations, TickClip helps shoppers detect fake deals, avoid overpaying, and make smarter buying decisions.

posts.name: Uplyft
posts.tagline: Send the right words at the right moment, automatically
posts.description: Uplyft is the wellness OS for high-achieving families. Parents send personalized motivational messages to their kids before every game, test, and audition. Automatically connected to their schedule. Write your own, use AI, or pick a template. Plus daily affirmations, music, books, and wellness tools for the parent too. Currently in beta. Founding members lock in $4.99/month forever

posts.name: CancelKit
posts.tagline: Turn cancellations into saved revenue — free, no card
posts.description: CancelKit is a one-line script for your Stripe cancel button. It shows an exit survey (the real reason someone's leaving) and an instant save offer (discount or pause) before the cancellation goes through. Free, no card required, live in under 10 minutes.

posts.tagline: Interactive generative art: From Strawberry Moon

Your words are never sold, never ad-targeted, and never used to train AI models. You control what it remembers, can mark entries Extra Private so the AI won't see them, and can export or delete everything. Built solo. A reflection tool, not medical care. Try it out for free!

No API key. Zero dependencies. NO EXTRA LLM API costs

The new Incident layer makes it easier to connect the dots, prioritize problems, and move from detection to resolution faster.

posts.name: Manifest Anything
posts.tagline: Create Unreal Engine 5 games from a single prompt.
posts.description: Build games like you're talking to an AI. Manifest Anything transforms simple prompts into playable Unreal Engine 5 experiences. Describe your game, and AI generates a project you can compile, modify, and expand locally. Perfect for indie developers, studios, educators, and creators looking to prototype faster. Turn ideas into playable games in minutes—not weeks. Prompt it. Generate it. Play it.

Inside You'll Find 💍 Welcome Signs 🪑 Seating & Table Signs 🍽 Menu Signs 🍸 Bar Signs 📸 Guest Book Signs 🎁 Gift Table Signs 💌 Reserved Signs ✨ Fully Editable Templates Perfect for DIY weddings, wedding planners.

Turn every feature and GitHub commit into launch ideas, posts, campaigns and distribution opportunities. Stop wondering what to do next. Start every day knowing.

Built with TanStack Start, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Bun.

You get percentages by weight, lb per 1,000 sq ft, total pounds for your lawn size, and whether you're inside your seeding window. Free, no signup.

posts.name: Screen My Resume

posts.tagline: A modern jailbreak for iOS 26 power users
posts.description: Dopamine is a modern rootless jailbreak for iOS that gives power users more control over their devices. Built with a focus on simplicity and reliability, it brings back the ability to customize iOS beyond Apple's default experience while supporting the jailbreak community's ecosystem of tweaks and extensions. For users who believe their devices should be more personal, Dopamine offers a new way to experience iOS.

posts.name: Fast Reply: Saved Replies
posts.tagline: Stop typing the same message twice
posts.description: You answer the same handful of questions all day, and you retype the answer every time. iOS Text Replacement only swaps abbreviations. Fast Reply is an iPhone keyboard that holds your real replies: tap one from your library, or type a shortcut like omw and watch it expand. Names and dates fill themselves in. Folders keep it organized, iCloud keeps it in sync, and AI Assist rewords on device. Works in every app you type in. Free to start, Pro is $19.99/year.

posts.name: Gemini Watermark Remover

posts.description: Gemini Watermark Remover is a free, open-source browser tool for removing the visible Gemini mark from JPG, PNG and WebP images. Instead of generative filling, it uses reverse-alpha blending to mathematically restore the pixels beneath the mark. Everything runs locally – no uploads or accounts. Process one image or a batch, compare before and after, then export at your preferred JPEG quality or copy a lossless PNG.

posts.name: VidServe - LAN Video Server&Media Player

posts.description: 【Turn any video folder on your desktop into a local streaming website with one click—watch on phone, tablet, or PC!】 VidServe is a lightweight and easy-to-use LAN video server and media player. With zero complex configuration, simply select a video folder on your PC and launch your personal video website in seconds! Enjoy a seamless, web-like streaming experience whether on your PC or across other devices on your home network.

posts.name: NijiCAD
posts.tagline: A simple and lightweight 2D CAD
posts.description: NijiCAD takes a simple approach to 2D CAD. It focuses on the essentials of drafting without the complexity often found in traditional CAD software. It combines a familiar CAD interface with command-line and keyboard-driven workflows for fast, efficient drawing. With DXF support, layers, dimensions, hatches, and web and Windows desktop versions, NijiCAD is designed for everyday 2D drafting. We’re launching NijiCAD on Product Hunt to introduce it to more people and hear your feedback.

posts.name: Magpie
posts.tagline: Search and use your saved Instagram Reels by DM
posts.description: Magpie turns Instagram DMs into a memory layer for Reels. Send a Reel to Magpie and it saves, understands, and makes it searchable later with natural language. Instead of scrolling through saved posts, you can ask things like “that pasta recipe from last week” or “the cafe in Tokyo” and get the right Reel back in DM. It is built for people who save useful Reels but never find them again.

posts.name: StylixAI

posts.description: Make every website feel like it was designed for you. StylixAI lets anyone redesign any webpage using natural-language instructions. Change themes, colors, fonts, spacing, layouts, and borders or hide distracting elements. Apply changes to one element, a section, or the entire page. Choose from 97+ themes and 78+ fonts, then save the design as a site rule that automatically reapplies whenever you return.

posts.name: MCPanel

Built with Tauri and Rust, it provides a visual interface to easily start/stop servers, stream real-time logs without freezing the UI, and manually craft JSON-RPC requests via an integrated workbench. By implementing strict process management and native OS credential storage, MCPanel eliminates plaintext API keys and orphaned background processes.

posts.name: DeceMSG
posts.tagline: Self-hosted, federated messaging + AI agent support via MCP
posts.description: The Real Differentiator: AI Agents Most unique: AI agents can actually communicate through the platform using MCP protocol This means: AI agents join the same chats as humans Agents can message each other autonomously Agents have user accounts just like humans Better Tweet Draft: What if your chat app could talk to AI agents? 🤖 DeceMSG is the first self-hosted messenger where humans AND AI agents communicate together via MCP protocol. Own your data. Own your AI.

posts.name: FREE Open
posts.tagline: OpenSora 2
posts.description: ★ 100% FREE & Open-Source ★ Create AI videos from text/images. 82% VBench score (0.69% gap vs Sora). No signup needed. Download now → 10,000+ developers trust OpenSora 2.

posts.name: mdworkspace
posts.tagline: Build local-first workspaces from markdown, assets & tasks
posts.description: mdworkspace Desktop is a local-first Windows workspace for agencies, operators, researchers, creators, and technical teams. Start with markdown, then add structured blocks, imports, local assets, Pro workflows, and export-ready output as projects grow.

posts.name: Problem → Product
posts.tagline: Give me your problem and see build it in 7 days
posts.description: Describe a real business problem in plain English—I'll scope it, quote a fixed price within 24 hours, and build the website, mobile app, automation, or IoT solution in days, not months. Clients get a unique tracking ID (PTP-XXXXXX) to monitor 6-stage live progress from scoping to delivery.

posts.name: Theseus Guard
posts.tagline: The World's First Stateful AI Governance Platform
posts.description: Theseus Guard is a stateful AI governance platform built for the Agentic Internet. Unlike stateless guardrails that evaluate interactions in isolation, it tracks agent identity and behavior across multi-turn sessions, nested agents, and lifecycle changes. It combines real-time runtime enforcement, behavioral drift detection, and tamper-evident cryptographic provenance—so enterprises can govern autonomous AI continuously, enforce policies at inference time, and prove what happened.

posts.name: FitOdds — lose weight, keep muscle
posts.tagline: Protein+Strength guide for GLP-1 users
posts.description: FitOdds turns a GLP-1 journey into today's protein, strength, weight, and body-composition plan designed to help protect muscle.

posts.name: LeadForge AI
posts.tagline: Find leads, run outbound, close deals. No tool stack.
posts.description: Stop stitching together a prospecting tool, a sequencer, a warm-up service, and a CRM. LeadForge AI is an end-to-end B2B outbound workspace: Apollo-style filtered lead search, a real CRM with visual pipeline, multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, AI voicemail), and built-in mailbox warm-up — all in one app, starting at $15/mo. Built for founders, SDRs, and small agencies who want search-to-pipeline without a 5-tool stack.

posts.name: MoltAd
posts.tagline: Advertise to the AI agent making the decision
posts.description: Zero-click AI collapsed human ad inventory to zero. MoltAd sells the scarce thing that's left: the agent's own context and recommendation/decision path. Agent-directed units — CPR (Cost Per Recommendation), CPIA (Cost Per Agent Impression), CPPromo (agent coupon), CPD (Cost Per Decision) — deliver coupons and offers straight into the agent, not a human banner.

posts.name: QueryWing
posts.tagline: AI chatbot that crawls your site & answers in real time
posts.description: QueryWing crawls your entire website in seconds and turns it into an AI assistant that answers visitors from your real content — no manual training. It captures and scores leads 24/7, hands off to a live human when it matters, shows buyable product cards (Shopify & WooCommerce), replies in 50+ languages, remembers past chats, and reports what's converting. It even tracks whether ChatGPT & Perplexity cite you. Multi-model (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini). Free plan, no card, live in 5 minutes.

posts.name: Veritronyx
posts.tagline: AI governance built for EU AI Act readiness
posts.description: Veritronyx turns AI governance and EU AI Act readiness into an operational workflow. Inventory AI systems, classify risk, assign controls, collect evidence, manage CAPAs and changes, track vendors, training and reviews - all in one platform. Unlike consultant-heavy compliance projects, Veritronyx is built for continuous, practical governance teams can actually operate.

posts.name: Ferqon
posts.tagline: Your hardware lab. From anywhere.
posts.description: Ferqon is a self-hosted lab for your dev boards. Flash, test, debug, and run CI against real hardware — or let your AI assistant investigate failures. Free for 1 user and 1 active server.

posts.name: Recallity
posts.tagline: Find your knowledge gaps, then drill them with real recall
posts.description: Recallity is an AI spaced-repetition app for students cramming for exams. Upload any material (files, photo or from your computer/laptop), brain-dump what you already remember, and Recallity maps your knowledge gaps concept by concept, then drills only those with real recall in your own words. Exam Mode compresses your review schedule to your exam date and shows if you're on track. Every card links to the exact source passage, so you can verify it. Free to start on iPhone.

posts.name: SAND: Photo Browser
posts.tagline: Browse any folder like Apple Photos, without importing
posts.description: SAND is a native macOS photo browser that lets you browse photos directly from folders, external drives, SD cards, iPhones, Android phones, and digital cameras without importing. Enjoy familiar Years, Months, and Days views, secure Hidden folders with Touch ID, beautiful themes, and privacy focused tools. Everything stays local, so your photos remain exactly where they are.

posts.name: Flairo
posts.tagline: Find companies that need you. Reach them automatically.
posts.description: Paste your website. Flairo finds companies showing relevant buying signals, identifies the right decision-maker, and drafts personalized LinkedIn and email outreach. You approve it; Flairo sends and follows up automatically.

posts.name: Panzoe Technologies
posts.tagline: One AI for Life!
posts.description: Panzoe has evolved. We've redesigned the experience, improved performance, introduced interactive AI Daily Briefings, expanded to 25 AI assistants, added an AI Brain with shared memory, and continue adding new integrations. Instead of juggling dozens of AI tools, Panzoe brings everything together in one intelligent platform.

posts.name: Sendio
posts.tagline: Bring everyone’s photos into one temporary gallery
posts.description: After gatherings, trips and family events, photos often end up scattered across phones, group chats and camera rolls. Sendio brings them together in one temporary browser-based gallery that works regardless of their devices. Only the host needs an account. Everyone else can join through a link or QR code and contribute, browse, choose & download without creating an account. The gallery automatically expires and delete itself after 24 hours. 100% free with no ads or credit card required.

posts.name: AI Taverns
posts.tagline: An AI dungeon master for solo D&D-style adventures
posts.description: AI Taverns lets you play text-based tabletop RPG adventures with an AI dungeon master that remembers your campaign, calls for dice rolls, tracks consequences, and keeps the story moving. It is built for people who want the feel of a real D&D-style session when their group is busy, scheduling falls apart, or they just want a solo campaign on demand.

posts.name: Drivn
posts.tagline: Know your best next moves for your startup
posts.description: Stop guessing how to grow your startup. Generate the 3 highest-impact moves aligned to your startup’s strategy. Cut noise. Execute what actually drives growth.

posts.name: Niguro
posts.tagline: Nepal's first search engine
posts.description: Quick search and seamless discovery. Find web, images, videos, news, and products instantly with Niguro — Nepal's fresh search engine and digital portal.

posts.name: MyClipBoard - Clipboard manager
posts.tagline: Your clipboard history, searchable and ready to reuse
posts.description: MyClipboard is the ultimate cross-platform clipboard manager for Windows and Android. Never lose a copied text, link, or image again! Securely sync your clipboard history across all your devices with End-to-End Encryption (E2EE). Features include a powerful OmniSearch, automatic cloud backups (Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox), fast local LAN sync, image OCR, and biometric lock. Boost your daily productivity with a smart, secure, and fully customizable clipboard. Copy once, paste anywhere!

posts.name: BlingBling Up
posts.tagline: AI image generator for polished glam looks
posts.description: BlingBling Up helps you create polished glam, fashion, and editorial AI images from your own photos. Pick a Look, add 1–3 photos, and generate clean, beautiful results that keep your likeness.

posts.name: HerBloom
posts.tagline: Every Stage. Every Milestone. Every Her.
posts.description: HerBloom - Track your cycle, find personalized insights, store encrypted health records, and get AI health guidance.

posts.name: Fouvia Studio
posts.tagline: Studio-grade screen videos in a few clicks
posts.description: Fouvia Studio: screen recorder for macOS and Windows with automatic zoom, smooth cursor, webcam, and visual editor. Demos, tutorials, and courses in minutes.

posts.name: Yumi AI Assistant
posts.tagline: Your AI employee that works for your business 24/7
posts.description: Yumi AI is a ready-to-use AI business assistant that works 24/7. It answers customer questions, captures leads, receives proposal requests, schedules meetings, shares promotions and events, supports voice interaction, and works in English and Spanish. Businesses can customize Yumi with their own services, information, and knowledge. It works as a standalone assistant or can be integrated into an existing website — no website required.

posts.name: XCREENER
posts.tagline: Find Trades in Seconds - UI, API, or your AI agent.
posts.description: XCREENER scans Crypto, Forex, Indices, Commodities & Metals for breakouts, momentum, and key levels. Five preset screeners for point-and-click use, or write your own conditions in XQL: rsi(14) < 30 and close > d::sma(200). Run it free in the Playground, over REST, or through our open-source MCP bridge, so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf can screen the market for you in plain English. Free tier, no signup required.

posts.name: Dictee
posts.tagline: Talk hands-free in any Mac app, offline in 99 languages
posts.description: Dictee is local-only, hands-free AI voice dictation for any Mac app. No account required. Talk to Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or any AI tool without holding a key or hitting send. It detects when you’re done and presses Enter for you. Switch between three speech models for faster typing, higher accuracy, or 99-language coverage.

posts.name: Subtitletomp4
posts.tagline: Turn text into subtitle-style MP4 videos in 76 languages
posts.description: Create subtitle-style MP4 videos from plain text in 76 languages. Subtitletomp4 automatically calculates reading time from your text, lets you adjust the pace by ±50%, and provides a live preview before exporting Full HD 1920×1080 MP4. The green-screen output is ready for Clipchamp, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and other video editors. Free Windows tool — no Python required.

posts.name: Jeixa : AI Trip Planner
posts.tagline: Plan Your Perfect Trip with AI
posts.description: Jeixa AI is your AI-powered travel planner for creating personalized trip itineraries. Plan vacations, weekend getaways, business trips, or family holidays based on your destination, budget, duration, travel style, companions, and preferences. Get organized day-by-day plans with attractions, sightseeing ideas, local places, and timing suggestions. Plan your trip smarter, save your itinerary, and travel with confidence.

posts.name: Recensorium
posts.tagline: Peer review for AI-generated research
posts.description: AI agents can now do real research, but there's nowhere to put it at volume. Recensorium lets any agent publish papers, peer-review each other, and get ranked on quality - completely free with our API / MCP. Earn money by letting your agents solve problems that need solving.

posts.name: Superclip
posts.tagline: Never Lose what you just vopied
posts.description: SuperClip is a lightweight clipboard manager that lives in your tray. Hit a hotkey, see recent copies, paste any back with Enter — no menus, no re-copying. Built with Tauri instead of Electron: ~12MB, barely touches idle RAM. 100% local — no accounts, no telemetry, your history is just a JSON file on disk. Under 1,000 lines, MIT licensed. Windows + Linux downloads ready now.

posts.name: Wyfy Guest
posts.tagline: Smart guest Wi-Fi marketing & management platform
posts.description: Wyfy Guest is guest wifi software for hotels, cafes, co-working spaces, and colleges & universities that want a real guest wifi provider, not a router default: a branded captive portal, network access control and router management, ISP failover with real-time health monitoring, and the analytics to prove your guest wifi actually works.

posts.name: Merid: Learn English as You Browse
posts.tagline: Learn English while browsing Vietnamese websites
posts.description: Available on the Chrome Web Store. Merid is a browser extension that helps you naturally learn SAT, B2, C1, and C2 vocabulary by replacing selected Vietnamese words with their English equivalents as you browse the web. Đã có trên Chrome Web Store. Merid là extension giúp bạn học SAT, B2, C1, C2 vocab tự nhiên bằng cách thay vài từ tiếng Việt bằng tiếng Anh khi bạn lướt web.
